release: Smart Import Duplicate Protection & Diagnostics Refinement
name: Smart Import Duplicate Protection & Diagnostics Refinement
changes: Blocks unattended TV Smart Import before commit when incoming media is byte-identical to a different episode of the same library title; the downloaded output is preserved for Needs Review.
Detects identical bytes across two different episode files inside the same incoming season pack before either file is committed.
Demotes stale SAB engine warnings to resolved historical evidence when the exact named release is already owned by successful durable terminal history, without altering SAB logs.
Separates raw SAB per-slot Active overlap from actual visible-card corrections and bounds overlap examples instead of transporting long UUID signatures.
Caches one coherent /api/diagnostics generation for 1.5 seconds so JSON diagnostics and the text report can reuse expensive Downloads/Automation/storage aggregation.
Preserves the v3.6.55 terminal-history no-op fast path, private SABnzbd 5.1.2 authority, NZB identity gate, Smart Import ownership, Library Integrity and runtime handoff.
regression_guards: Incoming TV media matching another episode fingerprint must fail closed before Smart Import commit and preserve the source for review.
Two incoming episode targets with identical bytes must be detected before a season-pack transaction commits either file.
A stale SAB warning naming a durably Completed release must leave current engine_warnings while remaining available as resolved historical warning evidence.
Raw SAB Active-slot overlap must use bounded count/example telemetry and must not increment visible multi-active correction telemetry by itself.
Diagnostics snapshot/report requests within the short cache TTL must be able to reuse one coherent generation.
All v3.6.55 history-efficiency and durable diagnostics guards plus prior production regressions remain mandatory.
